headline: Make release verification deterministic and current

items.title: Prove early reaction clicks before installing the handler
items.insight: The reaction replay fixture calls an assumed early click after only a300ms response delay; the failed run observed both clicks before replay completed. Replace the response sleep with a held promise. Assert the early click precedes handler installation, then release it; prove the live second click is delivered once before and after the late script completes.
items.evidence: Run the actual after-paint browser file: queued A is superseded by live B, completion does not replay B, and a later normal click is handled once. Preserve the preceding two-bar latest-tap case.

items.title: Finish candidate-origin browser checks with bounded cleanup
items.insight: Actual candidate-origin browser assertions reached fixture cleanup and failed with Windows EPERM on its guarded temporary directory. Use the existing Node recursive-removal retry options on this exact guarded fixture root. Retain origin/decoy assertions, process close waits, root guards and server cleanup. Keep terminal cleanup failures visible.
items.evidence: Run the real browser-collection unit file including broken-candidate and decoy mutation controls; require native exit0 and no fixture child remaining. No test retry or assertion removal.

items.insight: The freshly generated brief says548/548 passing and Deploy verified while the latest native source attempt failed129 after128/549 and S409 release is pending.
